Metadata.title: Seedreign
Metadata.titleDefault: Seedreign · Take the world before it collapses
Metadata.description: A free .io strategy game. One new world every dawn, the same seed for every player, gone by nightfall. Runs in your browser in 7 to 25 minutes.
Metadata.keywords: io game, strategy game, territory conquest, daily game, browser game, free to play, roguelike, multiplayer

Footer.tagline: One world a day, the same seed for every player, gone by nightfall.

Hero.subtitle: Territory strategy. A fresh procedural world every day. Share your result.
Hero.note: Free. No download, no account, one tap.

WhatIsIt.title: Four things make it Seedreign
WhatIsIt.description: One world. One seed. Everybody plays the same map, and by nightfall it is gone.

daily.title: A new world at dawn
daily.body: One seed sows the map, and it is the same map for every player on the planet. Nobody draws an easier world than you did.

skill.title: Taken on skill
skill.body: Territory, timing, your commander's abilities and whatever you dare grab off the map. Cards are one layer of seven, never the whole game.

living.title: The map fights back
living.body: Rivers flood, faults tear the land open, vaults crack. Then the Collapse eats the edges and forces the last fight.

share.title: Then you post the grid
share.body: Every run ends in a spoiler free grid of your world. Drop it in the group chat and let everyone compare the same day.

NotFound.title: This world collapsed
NotFound.description: Nothing left to conquer at this address. A new one is sown at dawn.
